invariants.rationale: Font scale is often used as a multiplier for graphical size and is typically non-negative.
fontScale should be a finite float to produce meaningful visual scaling; infinite or NaN values are usually undesired.
A scale of zero would make text invisible or degenerate; often applications restrict font scale from being zero.
Font scale rarely exceeds a certain maximum; very large values may indicate misuse.
Font scale is rarely extremely negative; such values likely indicate an error.
